coldCumulativeBudget.before: A cold invocation sent attempt 3, exceeded its captured wait allowance and returned 200. Expected 503 with its due time.
coldCumulativeBudget.after: At virtual t=80 ms a cold resume returned 503. At t=145 ms the 15 ms remaining fit the budget. Attempt 3 began at t=160 ms, 95 ms total charged wait.

workflowPhysicalBudget.before: A parent with one available call accepted two physical POSTs after a confirmed 503.
workflowPhysicalBudget.after: Both the one-call parent and the USD 0.15 parent refuse the second physical send. Two available calls retain the first reservation and settle the successful second one. Fresh application scopes restored from snapshots replayed the journal without a third POST.

pendingReceiptCooldown.before: A queued GET response with HTTP 200 or 202 and a 2500 ms cooldown returned an exception with no HTTP status or retry metadata.
pendingReceiptCooldown.after: Buffered and streaming calls retained the HTTP status, phase, original delay, earliest permitted GET, physical request ID and hashed provider ID. One POST and two GETs at virtual t=0 and t=2500 ms returned the completed receipt.

interruptedReceipt.before: The network, timeout and truncated receipt fixtures lost the physical phase or its classification.
interruptedReceipt.after: Response-header network loss, response-body timeout and truncated JSON returned typed diagnostics, local correlation and any observed status. All three recovered by GET on the exact response ID. Each fixture observed one POST and two GETs.
